items.name: glass-material
items.title: Glass material
items.description: Design tokens and the shared hook behind every Liquid Glass component.

items.name: glass-lens
items.title: Glass lens
items.description: The spring physics and the lifting glass lens shared by the switch, slider and tab bar.

items.name: glass-button
items.title: Glass Button
items.description: A real button in Liquid Glass, with primary and secondary variants, loading and disabled states.

items.name: glass-switch
items.title: Glass Switch
items.description: An iOS 26 switch: a white capsule that turns into a clear glass lens as it toggles, and stays glass while held.

items.name: glass-slider
items.title: Glass Slider
items.description: An iOS 26 slider: a white capsule on a thin track that lifts into a clear glass lens while you drag it.

items.name: glass-segmented-control
items.title: Glass Segmented Control
items.description: An iOS 26 segmented control: a white pill that rises into a glass lens you can drag between segments.

items.name: glass-tabs
items.title: Glass Tabs
items.description: Keyboard-accessible tabs with a moving glass indicator.

items.name: glass-tab-bar
items.title: Glass Tab Bar
items.description: An iOS-style tab bar or navigation with a magnifying glass lens you can drag between items.

items.name: glass-dialog
items.title: Glass Dialog
items.description: A modal dialog on a readable glass surface. Glass buttons inside it render as inset glass.

items.name: glass-card
items.title: Glass Card
items.description: A glass panel with header, content and footer. Glass buttons inside it render as inset glass.
